citations.quote: Name: Riven. Official role tags: Fighter, Assassin.

cards.purpose: Recognize Riven's fighting pattern and main defensive priorities.
cards.title: Riven

citations.quote: Innate: Riven's ability casts generate stacks of Charge, which stacks up to a cap. Riven's basic attacks consume a stack to deal bonus physical damage.

core_mechanics.summary: Ability casts charge basic attacks with bonus physical damage.

cards.purpose: Recognize the threat of attacks woven between casts.
cards.title: Runic Blade

citations.quote: Active: Riven can cast this ability up to three times in quick succession, dealing physical damage to enemies hit.
First Cast: Riven dashes forward and slashes her sword in a circle.
Second Cast: Riven mimics the first cast's effects.

core_mechanics.summary: A sequence of dashing physical-damage slashes.

citations.quote: Third Cast: Riven mimics the first cast's effects in a larger area while also knocking back enemies hit 75 units over 0.5 seconds. This cast can cross terrain.

core_mechanics.summary: The final slash has a larger area, knocks enemies back and can cross terrain.

cards.purpose: Recognize repeated dashes and anticipate the final crowd-control strike.
cards.title: Broken Wings

citations.quote: Active: Riven emits a flash of runic energy, dealing physical damage and briefly stunning nearby enemies.

core_mechanics.summary: Physical damage and a brief stun around Riven.

citations.quote: Active: Riven dashes in the target direction, though not through terrain, while granting herself a shield for 1.5 seconds.

core_mechanics.summary: A directional dash with a brief shield that cannot cross terrain.

citations.quote: Riven can cast any of her abilities during the dash.

core_mechanics.summary: Riven can cast abilities during the dash.

cards.purpose: Recognize her shielded repositioning and immediate follow-up threat.
cards.title: Valor

citations.quote: Active: Riven empowers her blade for some time, gaining bonus attack damage and increased range on her basic attacks, Broken Wings and Ki Burst. During this time, Riven can cast Wind Slash.

core_mechanics.summary: Temporary attack damage and reach increases unlock Wind Slash.

citations.quote: Active: Riven unleashes a wave of energy in a cone in the target direction that deals physical damage to enemies hit, increased by 0% – 200% (based on target's missing health).

core_mechanics.summary: Wind Slash deals cone-shaped physical damage that increases with the target's missing health.

cards.purpose: Recognize the empowered fighting window and its ranged finisher together.
cards.title: Blade of the Exile and Wind Slash

factual_risks: Base ability cooldown durations are not supplied; precise punish windows cannot be established.
Broken Wings has a limited recast window before entering cooldown; tracking casts does not establish immediate availability of the next full sequence.
Ultimate cooldown availability is important but is not established by the supplied evidence.

citations.quote: During this time, Riven can cast Wind Slash.

relationships.condition: While Blade of the Exile is active.

section_disposition.reason: Primary dash sequence and final crowd control.
The finisher is taught with the ultimate that unlocks it.

summary: An overview and primary ability cards teach Riven's charged attacks, dash sequence, nearby stun, shielded dash and ultimate, with Wind Slash merged into its unlocking ability.
